This directory contains the browser player and WebAssembly output from
[`otya128/mpeg2toh264`](https://github.com/otya128/mpeg2toh264), MIT licensed.

Upstream revision: `7b008c64c2ff6b5bbca54232712276c852d1e194`.

The player source and matching WASM glue/module were copied from
`packages/player/src` and the output of `tools/build-wasm.sh`. Keep the
upstream `LICENSE` with these files when redistributing.
